title: Potato: Core Value
description: An optimization modpack designed to boost FPS and minimize lag on a potato of a pc!
body:
## 1.0.0-1.21.11

_Potato: Core Value_ is a modpack that aims to significantly boost fps and minimize lag with the bare bones of my Potato modpacks and disregarding some aethetic visuals. The modpack comes with minimal resource packs, primarily to make gui navigation easier, as well as a few low-end shaders to choose from. This is the very first version of _Potato: Core Value_ and may contain some areas that require improvement.
